name: SamSUCKS
description: Fast from-scratch Plex client for Samsung Tizen 6.5+ TVs: smooth scrolling, hardware AVPlay playback with direct play, instant search, audio/subtitle picker and up-next autoplay. Plain JavaScript, no framework.
pre_build: rm -rf app/js/dev && VERSION=$(sed -n 's/.*widget.* version="\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' app/config.xml) && sed -i "s/^export const VERSION = .*/export const VERSION = '$VERSION';/" app/js/config.js && PRELOADS=$(cd app && find js -name '*.js' | sort | sed 's|.*|<link rel="modulepreload" href="&">|' | tr '\n' ' ') && sed -i "s|</head>|$PRELOADS</head>|" app/index.html
